note: prêt à terme du 19 juillet 2024 (agent Bank of America, N.A.) remboursé par anticipation et résilié le 1er novembre 2024
quote: On November 1, 2024, Super Micro Computer, Inc. (the "Company") prepaid in full and terminated its obligations under the Term Loan Credit Agreement, dated as of July 19, 2024, by and among the Company, the lenders party thereto, and Bank of America, N.A., as the administrative agent, as amended or otherwise modified.
